title: Drik Panchang Pithoragarh direct-page Tara Asta benchmark
captureMethod: Playwright Chromium; HTTP 200; each page body and title independently confirmed Pithoragarh, Uttarakhand, India and the requested planet; no New Delhi fallback
normalizationRule: For source clock HH:MM where HH >= 24, add floor(HH/24) civil days to the source-printed date and use HH mod 24 as local clock; preserve raw date/clock and normalized local/UTC instants.
provenancePolicy: Direct named-city pages only. Source coordinates/elevation are undisclosed; use for same-city city-label validation, not strict coordinate-exact validation. The 2027 Mars page loaded and confirmed the city/planet but yielded no Asta boundary rows; this is recorded as no rows extracted, not proof of no event.
